title: FormalEvolve: Neuro-Symbolic Evolutionary Search for Diverse Autoformalization
abstract: arXiv:2603.19828v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Autoformalization aims to produce formal statements that compile and faithfully preserve the intended meaning of informal mathematics. Yet standard single-output evaluation collapses this many-to-many structure into a single prediction. For downstream proving, this granularity is too coarse: a formal statement is not merely a faithful translation endpoint, but also a prover-facing interface whose structure can alter proof search under a fixed budget. We therefore recast autoformalization as budgeted test-time search: FormalEvolve maintains a compilation-feasible archive for reuse and returns a deduplicated, semantically accepted repertoire for evaluation and downstream proving. It expands the archive with LLM-driven mutation, crossover, bounded patch repair, and symbolic abstract syntax tree (AST) rewrites for structural diversity. translated_abstract: 自动形式化旨在生成能够编译通过且忠实保留非形式化数学预期语义的形式化命题。然而，标准的单输出评估将这种多对多的结构压缩为单一预测。对于下游证明而言，这种粒度过粗：形式化命题不仅是忠实的翻译终点，更是面向证明器的接口，其结构会在固定预算下影响证明搜索。因此，我们将自动形式化重新构建为有预算的测试时搜索：FormalEvolve 维护一个可编译的存档以供复用，并返回一个去重且通过语义审核的候选集，用于评估与下游证明。该方法通过 LLM 驱动的变异、交叉、有界补丁修复以及符号化的抽象语法树（AST）重写来扩展存档，从而实现结构多样性。在生成器调用预算 T=100 并使用固定的 LLM 语义裁判的条件下，FormalEvolve 的 SH@100 达到……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 FormalEvolve 框架，将自动形式化重新构建为有预算的测试时搜索，通过 LLM 驱动的变异、交叉与符号 AST 重写维护可编译存档，生成多样化且语义通过审核的形式化命题，以更好地服务下游证明。
en_tdlr: FormalEvolve recasts autoformalization as budgeted test-time search, maintaining a compilation-feasible archive expanded via LLM-driven mutation, crossover, and symbolic AST rewrites to produce diverse, semantically accepted formal statements for downstream proving.
